title: Stop rehearsing
hook: Stop rehearsing the conversation. Notice what you keep editing instead.
body_or_script: Replay keeps editing the same line. The interesting edit is the one you keep changing. Notice the question, not just the moment.
caption: Edit the question.
asset_note: Do not call replay a red flag.
notes: Manual publish only after Day012 checklist is clear.

title: Replay vs repair
hook: Replay loops the same line. Repair rewrites the question.
body_or_script: Two different verbs. Replay is reading. Repair is rewriting. The reading is a private start, not a public move.
caption: Two verbs.
asset_note: Avoid presenting repair as a guaranteed outcome.
notes: Manual publish only after Day012 checklist is clear.

title: Reread or rewrite
hook: You can reread the message forever and still not know what to say next.
body_or_script: Rereading keeps the same answer. Rewriting changes the question. Try the private Love Test for a clearer prompt, not a louder one.
caption: Rewrite, not reread.
notes: Manual publish only after Day012 checklist is clear.

title: Three small edits
hook: Three small edits that turn replay into a workable question.
body_or_script: Carousel: 1) Replace the question mark with a statement. 2) Remove the other person for a moment. 3) Ask what you actually need to know.
caption: Three small edits.
notes: Manual publish only after Day012 checklist is clear.

title: Replay vs repair framing
hook: Why replay vs repair is a more useful frame than should I text them.
body_or_script: SEO outline: 1) What replay does. 2) What repair does. 3) Why the question shape matters. 4) Where to start privately.
